Certificate of Completion of Work
This is to certify that the work of “Material Handling Plant — Madhya Pradesh Pkg-68” (industrial
epc), awarded to M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN
NAICC4417O) , has been completed in all respects on January 8, 2013 at a gross executed value of
INR 43,42,00,000/- (Rupees 43.42 Crore Only).
On joint measurement and final inspection, the executed quantities were found in order and the
workmanship conforming to the technical specifications forming part of the contract.
The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Priti Pillai. This certificate is issued for record
and for submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish past
performance.
Executive Engineer
Mega Infrastructure Authority
